sources.title: T.11 explicit arithmetic and denominator counterexamples
sources.details: Given original 80000 bytes and 4 correct out of 5, new 60000 bytes and 3 correct out of 5: size difference 60000−80000=−20000 bytes and ratio 60000/80000=3/4. Retained-score predicate is 3≥4, false; 4/5=0.8 and 3/5=0.6. The acceptance rule is (new size<original size) AND (new correct≥original correct), hence false. To check equal aggregate counts with different errors, vectors A=(1,1,1,1,0), B=(0,1,1,1,1) both sum to 4 with denominator5, but fail on positions5 and1 respectively. Removing A’s one wrong item produces4/4=1 rather than4/5=0.8 and changes the evaluation population. All are assumed integers, not model measurements.
